==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Egwene al'Vere]]}}

[[Egwene al'Vere|Egwene]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara|Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne]] are conducting their investigation into the [[Black Ajah]] in Nynaeve's room. Elayne is reading the notes they received from [[Verin]] while Nynaeve paces in the room. Egwene had a restless night sleeping with many dreams and nightmares. She is reluctant to speak to [[Anaiya Carel|Anaiya]] about them now because she feels any [[Aes Sedai]] could be Black Ajah. She did learn from Anaiya months before that a [[Dreaming|Dreamer]]'s dreams about ''[[ta'veren]]'' are basically always significant. She is trying to sort out if some of the dreams have meaning.

* Seanchan collaring a long line of women who wore Great Serpent Rings and forcing them to attack the White Tower{{ref|The Seanchan attack the White Tower at the end of ''[[The Gathering Storm]]'', [[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 39|Chapter 39]].}}
*Whitecloaks binding her fathers hands{{ref|The [[Whitecloak]]s invade the [[Two Rivers]] in ''[[The Shadow Rising]]''.}}
*Rand reaching for a crystal sword while a net descends on him{{ref|[[Be'lal]]'s trap for Rand when he takes ''[[Callandor]]''. ''[[The Dragon Reborn]]'', [[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 55|Chapter 55]].}}
*Rand kneeling while many little dragons settle on to his skin{{ref|Fulfilled in ''[[The Shadow Rising]]'', [[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 34|Chapter 34]].}}
* Rand walking in to a hole in a mountain{{ref|Fulfilled at the end of ''[[A Memory of Light]]'', [[A Memory of Light/Chapter 23|Chapter 23]].}}
* Rand confronting the Seanchan{{ref|Fulfilled in ''[[The Path of Daggers]]'', [[The Path of Daggers/Chapter 24|Chapter 24]].}}
*Perrin with [[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara|a female falcon]] on his shoulder{{ref|In early printings and in the Kate Reading audiobook, this dream originally read as "''Mat'' with a falcon on his shoulder, and Perrin..." It must be a typo and not a change though, because Perrin was already mentioned with the falcon and hawk in Min's vision in [[The Dragon Reborn/Chapter 6|Chapter 6]].}}
*Perrin with [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron|a female hawk]] trying to leash him
*Perrin with a beard [[Wolfbrother|leading a huge pack of wolves]]{{ref|Perrin leads the wolves in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] in {{6|55}}.}}
*Mat placing his left eye on a balance scale{{ref|Mat gives up an eye to free [[Moiraine]] from the [[Eelfinn]] in ''[[Towers of Midnight]]'', [[Towers of Midnight/Chapter 54|Chapter 54]].}}
* Mat hanging by his neck from a tree limb{{ref|Fulfilled in ''[[The Shadow Rising]]'', [[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 15|Chapter 15]].}}
*Mat and Seanchan{{ref|Mat eventually marries the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]] in ''[[Knife of Dreams]]'', [[Knife of Dreams/Chapter 36|Chapter 36]].}}
*Mat speaking the [[Old Tongue]]{{ref|One of Mat's gifts from the [[Eelfinn]]. ''[[The Shadow Rising]]'', [[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 15|Chapter 15]].}}

Nynaeve is frustrated that there is nothing useful in Verin's notes. Nynaeve tells Elayne to stop wasting her time, but Elayne just points out that they are all [[Accepted]] now and Nynaeve cannot order her. Elayne says they have no pattern in their birthdays, names, Ajahs or nationalities. The sisters are evenly distributed with two in each Ajah and Liandrin as the only [[Red Ajah|Red]]. This means there is a pattern in no pattern and that there must be more Black Ajah still in the tower. There must be an extended number of Black Ajah in order for them to be able to choose such an even distribution. Nynaeve agrees and compliments Elayne on her deduction.

They also have the list of the stolen ''[[ter'angreal]]''. Many have to do with dreaming and were last studied by [[Corianin Nedeal]].

*a [[clear crystal rod]], one foot long and one inch in diameter, use unknown.
*an [[alabaster figurine]] of an unclothed woman one hand tall, use unknown.
*an [[iron disc]] three inches in diameter with spirals engraved on both sides, use unknown.
*a wooden carving of a [[hedgehog]] the size of a man's thumb that makes one go to sleep.
*a [[fluted black rod]] of stone a pace long that produces [[balefire]].
*a carved cluster of [[six spotted dice]] that warps chance.

They continue to wonder if the Aes Sedai they are in contact with might be Black Ajah. Naturally, they think it is unlikely that the Aes Sedai they like are [[Darkfriend]]s. They discuss the probability that Verin genuinely missed the obvious pattern that so many of the ''ter'angreal'' were last studied by Corianin. They agree that [[Alanna Mosvani|Alanna]]'s behavior at the end of Egwene's testing was truly peculiar. They decide they will detail their suspicions to the [[Amyrlin Seat|Amyrlin]] but will let her draw the conclusions. Nynaeve wants to use the [[twisted stone ring]] that night but Egwene takes the ring, saying that she is the Dreamer and will be the one to use it.

[[Else Grinwell]]{{ref|Lanfear in disguise.}} comes into their room without knocking and probably heard some of the things they were discussing. She seemed to be looking at the dream ''ter'angreal''. She has a message from the Amyrlin that the belongings of [[Liandrin]] and her companions are in a storeroom. They are startled by Else's apparent knowledge of their task and decide it is necessary to talk to her about it. Egwene runs after Else and sees flashes of her white dress as she follows. But then she runs into a beautiful woman in silver and white{{ref|Lanfear, without disguise.}} who she assumes is an Aes Sedai she does not recognize. This woman apparently knows about the murders in the [[White Tower|Tower]] too. Egwene asks whether she has seen Else and the woman notes Else ran away quite quickly and is unlikely to be found now. She then tells Egwene to leave her be and Egwene starts going back to her room before she realizes what is happening. When she stops herself and turns back, the hallway is empty. She checks several more hallways but Else and the woman are nowhere to be found.
